title: Credit Analysts
description: Analyze credit data and financial statements of individuals or firms to determine the degree of risk involved in extending credit or lending money. Prepare reports with credit information for use in decisionmaking.

tasks.text: Analyze credit data and financial statements to determine the degree of risk involved in extending credit or lending money.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Analyzes structured financial data with tools

tasks.text: Complete loan applications, including credit analyses and summaries of loan requests, and submit to loan committees for approval.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Draft transaction docs; human owns legal risk

dwas.name: Prepare contracts or other transaction documents.

tasks.text: Generate financial ratios, using computer programs, to evaluate customers' financial status.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Organizational calculations from given data

dwas.name: Calculate data to inform organizational operations.

tasks.text: Prepare reports that include the degree of risk involved in extending credit or lending money.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Reports and budgets drafted; human owns assumptions

dwas.name: Prepare financial documents, reports, or budgets.

tasks.text: Analyze financial data, such as income growth, quality of management, and market share to determine expected profitability of loans.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Analyzes structured financial data with tools

tasks.text: Compare liquidity, profitability, and credit histories of establishments being evaluated with those of similar establishments in the same industries and geographic locations.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Market trend analysis from provided data

tasks.text: Consult with customers to resolve complaints and verify financial and credit transactions.
tasks.rationale: text generation — Written correspondence to customers is largely automatable

dwas.name: Correspond with customers to answer questions or resolve complaints.
dwas.gwa_name: Performing for or Working Directly with the Public

tasks.text: Contact customers to collect payments on delinquent accounts.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — In-person payment handling; some digital automation

dwas.name: Collect payments for goods or services.

tasks.text: Evaluate customer records and recommend payment plans, based on earnings, savings data, payment history, and purchase activity.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Financial status from documents, human verifies

dwas.name: Assess financial status of clients.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

dwas.name: Advise others on financial matters.
dwas.gwa_name: Providing Consultation and Advice to Others

tasks.text: Review individual or commercial customer files to identify and select delinquent accounts for collection.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Examines records for anomalies; human validates findings

dwas.name: Examine financial records.
dwas.gwa_name: Evaluating Information to Determine Compliance with Standards

tasks.text: Confer with credit association and other business representatives to exchange credit information.
tasks.rationale: decision support — Financial conferral aided; judgment and trust human

dwas.name: Confer with others about financial matters.
dwas.gwa_name: Coordinating the Work and Activities of Others
